# Inter

The typeface the dark theme uses, bundled so the app needs no web font service.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/rsms/inter |
| Release | v4.1 (`Inter-4.1.zip`) |
| File used | `web/InterVariable.woff2`, kept here as `InterVariable.woff2` and split by `scripts/split-inter.py` into `ui/src/assets/fonts/Inter-latin.woff2` and `Inter-other.woff2` (subset only; no glyph changed) |
| Licence | SIL Open Font License 1.1, reproduced in `LICENSE.txt` beside this file |
